rows: | 38 | 2026-09-03 15:10 | The solutions loop adopted from compound-engineering (user): `cheap-flow learnings` runs CE's `learnings-researcher` prompt verbatim (vendored, `<root>` → `docs`) on the researcher agent before brainstorm and plan, and its output feeds review (known pitfalls are blockers) and compound (update instead of duplicate); `cheap-flow compound` follows the `ce-compound` contract: schema.json (tracks, required fields, closed enums, corpus-first open vocabulary), the CE resolution template, parser-safety checks ported to TypeScript, one re-ask with the exact problems, category from the doc's own `category` when it is a real directory, `--update` with `last_updated`, ≤3 `CONCEPTS.md` proposals for Claude to apply, `Documentation complete` / `Documentation skipped` terminals. Not adopted: CE's Python validators (ported instead: the bundle must stay zero-dependency), the parallel research subagents and session-history probe of CE's Full mode (one researcher call is the point of this tree), instruction-file edits. The vendored markdown ships as JSON twins because the esbuild bundle has no text loader; a unit test keeps the pairs equal.
